modal.help_s1b: Activar Drives per entirs volumens, + Agiunscher ordinatur per agiunscher, x allontanescha in, u taidar paths separads cun `;` en Modifitgar. Midar il tab mida ils ordinaturs.
modal.help_s2b: Num, Regex (sintaxa Rust), Fuzzy, Cuntegn da datoteca, Glob (*.rs), In-da-quests (OR) / Nagin-da-quests (NOT), grondezzas (bytes u 10M/1G), datas (AAAA-MM-DD), Glista d'exclusiun, Extensiuns u chips da gruppa (remplazzan, cliccar danovamain per stizzar; Administrar modifitgescha las persunalisadas), Ignorar maiusclas/minusclas, Mussar zuppads.
modal.help_s3b: Buttun grond Scannar e tschertgar u Enter. Actualisar repeta cun tegnair la selecziun. Live exequi automaticamain (deactivà sco standard). Tschertgas vidas na curran mai — metter * en Glob per tut.
modal.help_s4b: Chaus pitschns sorteschan, Gia siglia paginas, chaschettas nutreschan Copiar paths / Spustar / Stizzar ed ils exports CSV–TXT–HTML–Excel–RTF. Tschertgas memorisadas e snapshots Ultimas restabileschan mintga filter inclusiv ordinaturs, OR/NOT e zuppads.
